text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute has accomplished great
things
during her first three years in the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The seasons have come and gone, each
one filled
with new meetings and
unexpected partings...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Including today's. Wonder Acute and I
have come
to the airport to see her
father off.

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Acute. Trainer. Take care of

yourselves!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: We will... But I'm still pretty shocked.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I never thought you'd be reviving your
boxing
career in the US.

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Well, I may be getting back in
the ring,
but not as a pro.

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text:
I can't let you upstage me, can I?
Besides, I still
got some unfinished
business to take care of!

text_block_list.name: Acute's Father
text_block_list.text:
Okay, you two! I'm leaving the gym in
your hands
while I'm gone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zoooom!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I don't imagine I've become that hard of hearing just yet...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But did he just ask us run the gym while
he's
gone?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Managing a boxing gym... That's one
heck of an
ask...

text_block_list.name: Boxing Students
text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Okay, everyone. Stooop! That'll do it for

roadwork. Next up...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's time for some shadowboxing! Let's
go!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Swishy-swish!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Students
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is still actively pursuing
her racing
career, but she's also taken
over her dad's boxing
gym.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's not a pro boxer herself, of course,
so the
guidance she can offer is limited.
Still...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It all comes down to charisma. With the
right level
of charm, just about anyone
will follow your lead.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My dad's boxing record is nothing
to sneeze
at, but it's his character that
drew so many
students to the gym.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I may not be able to teach them the
technique,
but I can light a fire in their
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the tenacity she showed in the
Twinkle
Series and the charisma she
inherited from her
father...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is a perfect symbol for
the gym.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: All that said, there are a lot of students. Motivating all of them and whipping them into shape is no small task...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if only another Umamusume were
around to
lend a hand...

Excuse me, but... if you need someone to
help
with roadwork, I would be happy to
assist.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... If it isn't Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You were so kind to me during the
holidays. It
isn't much, but I'd like to
return the favor
somehow. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Lo and behold, help has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, dearie. Well then,
um...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
First get changed, and then I'd like you
to carry
this.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A bamboo sword? What am I supposed
to do with
it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You just need to hold it, that's all. Now,
can I ask
you to motivate the students
with some tough
love?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So, hold the sword and dish out tough
love...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Got it. I'll get right on it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, maggots. There are two
outcomes to
any bout: win or perish.
Living with the shame of
defeat is the
height of folly.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Face your battles with conviction, and
understand
that any effort that doesn't
lead to results is
wasted.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student 1
text_block_list.text: Whoooa... Daaang...

text_block_list.name: Boxing Student 2
text_block_list.text:
She really means business. I feel like she
might
actually slice me in two if I lose...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What? I wouldn't go that far. However...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If that's what you think will motivate you
to
achieve victory, then I'm happy to
accommodate
you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Would you permit me to join this
organization,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, the new organizational
structure is in
place. The three of us will
manage the gym with
Wonder Acute
leading the way.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's all become champions! Me and
Grass in the
Twinkle Series, and
everyone else in the ring!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Now, let's start off with a run.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ready? One, two! ♪ One, two! ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: One, two! ♪ One, two! ♪

text_block_list.name: Boxing Students
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running as a single unit, our happy
shouts carry
over the river's surface.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're all moving toward glory,
supporting each
other and being
supported in turn.
